caseNameFull: George Fred Williams, of the Estate of Amey M. Starkweather, in Error v. Joseph U. Starkweather, Administrator, etc.
summary: In error to the. Supreme Court of the State of Rhode Island.
attorneys: Mr. James A. Halloran for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Edward D. Bassett for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam: Mr. James A. Halloran for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Edward D. Bassett for the defendant in error.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Loeber v. Schroeder, 149 U. S. 580, 585; Miller v. Cornwell, 168 U. S. 131; Fayerweather v. Ritch, 195 U. S; 299; Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 100.
